run_MDRunner_calculate: run a molecular dynamics simulation on a single structure using MDRunner calculate method
create_MDRunner: create an MDRunner instance with a calculator, thermostat, atoms, timestep, and total steps
save_MDRunner_simulation_state: save the MD simulation state including atoms, thermostat, and step count to a checkpoint directory
load_MDRunner_checkpoint: load MD simulation state from a checkpoint directory to resume from a previous step
write_MDRunner_results: write MD simulation results metadata as JSON to the results directory after simulation completes
